items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Professor Dedeson, he taught at school at New Orleans University at that time

ctx.x: About the same age as me then, a little bit younger than me.

Well I was born August 10th, 1905 and all around the house there, you know I always had inspiration to play music. My daddy tried to get me to play drums. You know I always talked to him about a set of drums. Because they needed a drummer in their band, you see they had, they called that band a spasm band. They had three-piece. They had a violin, guitar, and string bass. And so one day my brother saw a cornet, one of the short brass cornet. He bought the cornet for twelve dollars. So he came around the house, he…
Somebody made, there was Clarence Williams.
